bpRed: Blood pressure {sys}/{dia}: grade 2 hypertension. If it persists, see a doctor, the dose may need adjusting.
bpYellow: Blood pressure {sys}/{dia}: above 140/90. Measure twice a day, tell the doctor if it persists.
tempRed: Temperature {t} °C: during treatment, a reason to contact the doctor today.
diarrhea: Severe diarrhea: risk of dehydration, loperamide and water, tell the doctor.
handFoot: Marked reaction of the palms and soles: discuss a dose reduction with the doctor.
ivcG6pd: A high-dose vitamin C infusion, but MedControl has no G6PD result. In G6PD deficiency high doses cause hemolysis: upload the result (if you have one) or talk to your doctor.
